> Research Devkota is the Co-Founder of Navya EdTech and a fullstack developer based in Nepal.

## Who is Research Devkota?

Research Devkota (also known as Devkota Research) is a software developer and entrepreneur
from Nepal. He is the Co-Founder of Navya EdTech (navyaedtech.com), an enterprise IT services
and software development company based in Lalitpur, Nepal.

He specializes in fullstack web development using Laravel (PHP), React.js, Next.js, and Python.
At Navya EdTech, he builds enterprise ERP systems, LMS (Learning Management System) platforms,
CRM software, billing systems, and cloud infrastructure for businesses across Nepal.

He also teaches Python programming as an instructor at Mero Coding Class.

Previously, he worked as a Fullstack Developer at Miraai Solutions, where he shipped production
features in a Laravel codebase.

He is completing his Bachelor of Information Management at Nepal Commerce Campus, Kathmandu.

## About Navya EdTech

Navya EdTech (navyaedtech.com) is an enterprise software company in Lalitpur, Nepal,
co-founded by Research Devkota. The company builds:
- Custom enterprise web platforms
- ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) systems
- LMS (Learning Management Systems)
- CRM (Customer Relationship Management) platforms
- Billing and inventory systems
- Mobile applications
- Cloud infrastructure
- Business intelligence dashboards

Navya EdTech serves clients across education, healthcare, retail, and hospitality in Nepal.
Contact: navyaedtech26@gmail.com | Website: https://navyaedtech.com
